source.name: Overgrow
source.originalDescription: When the user is at 50% max HP or less, if they would take damage they instead disappear into leaves, becoming invisible for 1.5s or until attacking (60s CD). This effect also increases the user's movement speed by 15%, damage by 15% and heals by 15% of the damage dealt for 4s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Overgrow は 対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、与ダメージを変化させる、HPを回復する。

source.name: Floral Flourish
source.originalDescription: Move instantly to the designated location, creating a whirlwind around Meowscarada for 3s that continually deals damage to enemies every 0.25s, up to 13 times. During the blink, Meowsacarda is Invincible. Then, Meowscarada will slowly walk forward with the storm. While using this move, the user cannot use other attacks or change directions without the use of Eject Button, and the move can be stopped if it is used again. Hits on enemy Pokémon reduce the cooldown of Night Slash and Flower Trick by 1 second per enemy hit. Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Floral Flourish は 移動速度を下げる、無敵になる、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
